---
title: "2. Configure resting-state analysis"
---

## Terminal or graphical?

Start with the **terminal UI**, the default interface in HALFpipe. It guides you through configuring your data, preprocessing and features.

- [2.1 Terminal UI (recommended)](manual_old_ui.qmd)
- [2.2 Graphical UI (in development)](new_ui.qmd)

Both interfaces run inside the terminal, including over SSH. The newer graphical UI uses Textual to draw widgets such as tabs and buttons in the terminal. It does not require X forwarding or a desktop session.

Once your analysis is configured, continue to [3. Run and check outputs](check_run.qmd).
